# Security

Shoebill has an encrypted vault, so security reports matter.

**Report a problem privately.** Use GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" button on the
[Security tab](https://github.com/altyb/shoebill/security/advisories/new), or email altybanony@gmail.com.
Please do not open a public issue for a vulnerability. I will answer within a few days.

What helps: the app version, your Android version and phone, and the steps to reproduce.

**What counts.** A way to open the vault without the PIN, to read decrypted data from storage or a backup,
to bypass the lockout, or to make the app send data it should not. How the vault is protected, and what it
does not defend against, is written in the [README](../README.md#how-the-vault-is-protected).

Only the latest release gets fixes.
